references.purpose: grounded directional workstation-board layout only; rejected as trader workstation

prompt: Create a modular painted raster WORKSTATION source board for one Realm merchant animation: a grounded folding trade counter used for weighing and recording goods. It must read clearly beside a 35x46 strategy-game actor. Design: stout dark-oak folding counter with two visible trestle legs, a low red-madder cloth runner edged in peacock teal, an open cream ledger with bold blank ruled pages, three chunky nested brass trade weights, one compact wooden abacus, and a shallow empty goods tray. Keep props attached to/on the counter as one coherent grounded workstation; no hand balance tool because that is a separate authority. No person, garment, hands, cargo crate, loose coins, merchandise pile, building, scenery, floor, or text. Art direction: compact painterly pixel-art source material with crisp clusters, warm upper-left lighting, restrained oak/brass/madder/teal palette, bold readable silhouettes, classic strategy-game readability. Arrange four large, generously separated directional views on one board: front/down three-quarter, rear/up three-quarter, left side, right side; consistent counter identity and scale; ledger and brass weights visible in every view where perspective allows; every view fully visible and uncropped, with feet/base aligned conceptually to a ground line. Use a perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background with no gradient, cast shadow, labels, border, text, UI, watermark, duplicate fragments, or extra objects.
